metadata.description: Peter Grace's personal AI agent skills.

plugins.name: skill-authoring
plugins.description: Skills for writing and maintaining the agent skills in this repository.

plugins.name: github-workflows
plugins.description: Issue-to-merged-PR workflows on GitHub with the gh CLI: planning features and milestones into issues, grooming and splitting issues, implementing them in worktrees with subagents, answering review-bot feedback, burning down a backlog and closing out epics. Ships the issue-implementer subagent.

plugins.name: forgejo-workflows
plugins.description: Issue-to-PR workflows on Forgejo through the forgejo-mcp server: planning features into issues, grooming and splitting issues, implementing an issue as a pull request, and walking through review comments. Its subagent fan-out uses the issue-implementer agent from github-workflows.

plugins.name: usage-analysis
plugins.description: Skills for working out where Claude Code token usage goes, from local session transcripts: by model, token type, session and subagent type, with the fixes that cut it.

plugins.name: study-guides
plugins.description: Skills for writing grounded study documentation for a codebase (architecture overview, module deep dives, glossary, flashcards), fact-checking it against the code, and reconciling the fact-check back into the docs.
